register.title: PingYou Ltd's refined n153 certificate at 431186b, issue504
register.headline: A tighter rational realization of PingYou Ltd's packing of 153 squares
register.source_checks: The author reports that three exact checkers, its own rational polygon-projection checker and Evan Daniel's unchanged verify_cert.py and verify_cert2.py, accept all 153 squares, 612 wall conditions and 11,628 pairs; that its package replays the recorded rational construction and checks the lossless conversion to its corners Witness/v2; and that this repository's sqpack exact_verify and check_rational_witness_independent, unchanged at 074ac28, accept that witness. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit PingYou Ltd (https://github.com/BuddenPing/square-packing-certificates) with the n153 construction and this refinement of its certificate, as the source asks; by the source's account the construction starts from Ryan Xu's n70 construction (ry-xu, issue 432), taken from Evan Daniel's exact n70 certificate, its contacts reclosed at a new angle. The source names SQUISH's n153 (issue 481) only as its earlier comparison. The pinned source makes no statement about AI assistance; the author's statement on issue 503 of 12 October, 'Both solutions were AI assisted by "PY", an unreleased agentic AI offering by PingYou Ltd.', covers the n153 construction.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then decide whether it replaces T-148 at 153, which it improves by 1.00e-14: Mishapolk's #573 and #593 print smaller sides, and the author's own PR #574 states smaller ones still, so adoption waits on their imports. Final exact-head CI remains required.
